info.title: Everglow API
info.description: Photo-sharing platform for events — HTTP API contract (OpenAPI 3)

avatarUrl.description: Short-lived presigned URL of the profile avatar; null when none is set

usernameChangeAvailableAt.description: When the username can be changed again; null when it can be changed now. Usernames can be changed 2 times every 14 days, so the app can say when before the user tries.

termsAcceptedAt.description: When the user accepted the terms of use; null if they have not been asked yet.

suspendedAt.description: When the platform suspended the account, or null. A suspended account can read and delete itself; every other request answers 403 ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED.

username.description: Public handle. Trimmed and lowercased before validation.

acceptedTerms.description: The user accepted the terms of use, which forbid objectionable content and abusive behaviour. Required, and only `true` is valid; the acceptance time is recorded as termsAcceptedAt.

reason.description: Why the username is unavailable; null when available

AccountPlan.description: The caller's account plan. Every account is FREE until a host subscription exists.

activeEvents.description: Events the caller created that haven't closed, upcoming ones included, at once; null for no limit. Joined events never count.
Events the caller created that haven't closed, upcoming ones included.

galleryClosesAt.description: When the gallery closes; from then on the event no longer counts as active.

EventPlan.description: The plan a new event is created on.

plan.description: The plan a new event is created on.

galleryWindowOptions.description: The gallery lengths, in days, the host can pick, shortest first.

defaultGalleryWindowDays.description: The length a new event gets when none is picked: the longest. Null on a plan that never closes.

latestDate.description: The latest date a new event can have, 12 months from now. Any past date is allowed.

plan.description: The caller's account plan. Every account is FREE until a host subscription exists.

nextClosingEvent.description: The caller's active event whose gallery closes first, which frees a place for a new one; null when none of their active events is set to close.

username.description: Public handle. Trimmed and lowercased before validation.

uploadId.description: Pass it back to confirm the upload

uploadUrl.description: Presigned S3 PUT URL the client uploads bytes to

expiresAt.description: When uploadUrl stops being accepted; request a new one after this

uploadId.description: The uploadId returned when the upload URL was minted

ticketUrl.description: Auth0-hosted password change URL. Open in the system browser; do not embed in a WebView.

uploadUrl.description: Presigned S3 PUT URL the client uploads bytes to

expiresAt.description: When uploadUrl stops being accepted; mint a new slot after this

status.description: READY: the object was verified and the photo is now visible. MISSING: no object was uploaded; the slot has been released, mint a new one. MISMATCHED: the object differs from the declared size or type; it and the slot have been removed, mint a new one. NOT_FOUND: not a pending upload of the caller in this event.

addedById.description: Who uploaded the photo; null once that account has been deleted and the photo was kept for the event.

url.description: Presigned S3 GET URL, valid for a short period

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; pass it as ?cursor=. Null on the last page.

ReportStatus.description: ACTIONED: something was removed. DISMISSED: judged and left as it is. TARGET_GONE: closed without a verdict because what was reported was deleted.

ReportQueue.description: Who handles the report: ORGANIZERS, or PLATFORM once it is about an organizer, the gallery has closed, organizers left it for 24 hours, or an organizer dismissed a severe report. Organizers can't close PLATFORM reports (403 REPORT_ESCALATED).

ReportClosedReason.description: Why the report closed. Null while OPEN, and on reports closed before it was recorded.

ReportActorRole.description: In which capacity it was closed: ORGANIZER, PLATFORM, SUBJECT (the person it is about, e.g. deleting their own photo) or SYSTEM. Null while OPEN, and on reports closed before it was recorded.

eventId.description: Null once the event has been deleted; only closed reports outlive their event.

eventTitle.description: The event's title when the report was filed.

photoId.description: The reported photo. Null for MEMBER reports, and once the photo has been deleted.

reportedUserId.description: The reported member, or the uploader of the reported photo. Null once that account has been deleted, or when the photo had no uploader left.

status.description: ACTIONED: something was removed. DISMISSED: judged and left as it is. TARGET_GONE: closed without a verdict because what was reported was deleted.

queue.description: Who handles the report: ORGANIZERS, or PLATFORM once it is about an organizer, the gallery has closed, organizers left it for 24 hours, or an organizer dismissed a severe report. Organizers can't close PLATFORM reports (403 REPORT_ESCALATED).

closedReason.description: Why the report closed. Null while OPEN, and on reports closed before it was recorded.

closedByRole.description: In which capacity it was closed: ORGANIZER, PLATFORM, SUBJECT (the person it is about, e.g. deleting their own photo) or SYSTEM. Null while OPEN, and on reports closed before it was recorded.

resolvedById.description: Who closed the report, in the role closedByRole says. Null while OPEN, when nobody acted (SYSTEM), when the platform closed it, and once that account has been deleted.

note.description: Optional context for the organizers, in the reporter's own words.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; pass it as ?cursor=. Null on the last page.

ReportResolutionAction.description: REMOVE_PHOTO: delete the reported photo. REMOVE_MEMBER: remove the reported member from the event and ban them from rejoining through the invitation link, deleting the reported photo too when the report is about one. DISMISS: nothing was wrong; hidden content returns. Every action closes all OPEN reports on the same target.

MemberPhotos.description: REMOVE_MEMBER only (400 with any other action): what happens to the other photos the member uploaded to this event. KEEP (default): they stay. DELETE: they are all deleted, and their open reports are closed.

action.description: REMOVE_PHOTO: delete the reported photo. REMOVE_MEMBER: remove the reported member from the event and ban them from rejoining through the invitation link, deleting the reported photo too when the report is about one. DISMISS: nothing was wrong; hidden content returns. Every action closes all OPEN reports on the same target.

photos.description: REMOVE_MEMBER only (400 with any other action): what happens to the other photos the member uploaded to this event. KEEP (default): they stay. DELETE: they are all deleted, and their open reports are closed.

name.description: Null when the blocked account has no profile.

username.description: Public handle; null when the blocked account has no profile.

invitationUrl.description: Shareable invitation link for this access level

EventStatus.description: UNDER_REVIEW once enough members have reported the event itself: members keep access, but no one can join and no photos can be added until the platform finishes its review. SUSPENDED once the platform suspended it for breaking the terms: its photos, cover and description are hidden, and nothing about it can change (403 EVENT_SUSPENDED) until the platform restores it.

GalleryState.description: UPCOMING until galleryOpensAt: people can join, nobody can add photos, and the date and gallery length can still change. OPEN while photos can be added and downloaded. CLOSED once galleryClosesAt has passed: the photos are removed and the event itself stays. Separate from status, which is the moderation state.

members.description: Members of every role, organizers included; null for no limit.

storageBytes.description: The gallery's storage, in bytes as a decimal string; null for no limit.

members.description: Members of every role, organizers included.

storageBytes.description: Storage used by the gallery's photos, uploads in progress included, in bytes as a decimal string.

creatorId.description: Who created the event; null once that account has been deleted. Not a permission: see accessLevel.

invitationUrl.description: Participant invitation link. Prefer `invites` when present; kept for older clients that expect a single URL.

invites.description: Per-role invitation links. Populated for organizers; empty for other members so invite tokens are not leaked.

coverUrl.description: Short-lived presigned URL of the event cover image; null when none is set, or while it is hidden from the caller after a report of the event

status.description: UNDER_REVIEW once enough members have reported the event itself: members keep access, but no one can join and no photos can be added until the platform finishes its review. SUSPENDED once the platform suspended it for breaking the terms: its photos, cover and description are hidden, and nothing about it can change (403 EVENT_SUSPENDED) until the platform restores it.

plan.description: The plan the event is on. Its limits are in `limits`, which can include storage added to this event.

galleryState.description: UPCOMING until galleryOpensAt: people can join, nobody can add photos, and the date and gallery length can still change. OPEN while photos can be added and downloaded. CLOSED once galleryClosesAt has passed: the photos are removed and the event itself stays. Separate from status, which is the moderation state.

galleryOpensAt.description: When the gallery opens: the event's date, or when the event was created (or, while upcoming, rescheduled) if that date had passed.

galleryClosesAt.description: When the gallery closes: galleryOpensAt plus galleryWindowDays. Null on a plan that never closes.

galleryWindowDays.description: How many days the gallery stays open, as the host picked. Null on a plan that never closes.

galleryWindowOptions.description: The gallery lengths, in days, the event's plan offers, shortest first: what galleryWindowDays can be changed to while the event is upcoming.

deactivatedAt.description: When an organizer deactivated the event, closing its gallery early; null otherwise.

deactivatedById.description: The organizer who deactivated the event; null if nobody did, or once that account has been deleted.

date.description: When the event takes place: any past date, or at most 12 months ahead (newEvent.latestDate on GET /users/me/limits). The gallery opens then, or as soon as the event is created if that has passed.

galleryWindowDays.description: How many days the gallery stays open once it opens: one of newEvent.galleryWindowOptions on GET /users/me/limits. Defaults to the longest.

invitationUrl.description: Full invitation URL or invite token

description.description: A new description, or null to remove it.

date.description: A new date, any past one or at most 12 months ahead. Only while the event is upcoming, otherwise EVENT_SCHEDULE_LOCKED. The gallery then opens on it, or right away if it has passed.

galleryWindowDays.description: A new gallery length, one of the event's galleryWindowOptions. Only while the event is upcoming, otherwise EVENT_SCHEDULE_LOCKED.

avatarUrl.description: Short-lived presigned URL of the member's avatar; null when none is set

isBlockedByCaller.description: Whether the caller has blocked this member, so the client can offer to unblock. Blocks the other way round are never exposed.

name.description: Null when the account has no profile.

username.description: Public handle; null when the account has no profile.

quarantined.description: Whether the reported object was copied to evidence before it was deleted.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the evidence copy.

subjectUserId.description: The reported member, the photo's uploader, or who set the cover, as at filing.

eventId.description: Null once the event has been deleted; only closed reports outlive their event.

eventTitle.description: The event's title when the report was filed.

photoId.description: The reported photo. Null for MEMBER reports, and once the photo has been deleted.

reportedUserId.description: The reported member, or the uploader of the reported photo. Null once that account has been deleted, or when the photo had no uploader left.

status.description: ACTIONED: something was removed. DISMISSED: judged and left as it is. TARGET_GONE: closed without a verdict because what was reported was deleted.

queue.description: Who handles the report: ORGANIZERS, or PLATFORM once it is about an organizer, the gallery has closed, organizers left it for 24 hours, or an organizer dismissed a severe report. Organizers can't close PLATFORM reports (403 REPORT_ESCALATED).

closedReason.description: Why the report closed. Null while OPEN, and on reports closed before it was recorded.

closedByRole.description: In which capacity it was closed: ORGANIZER, PLATFORM, SUBJECT (the person it is about, e.g. deleting their own photo) or SYSTEM. Null while OPEN, and on reports closed before it was recorded.

resolvedById.description: Who closed the report, in the role closedByRole says. Null while OPEN, when nobody acted (SYSTEM), when the platform closed it, and once that account has been deleted.

reporterId.description: Null once that account is deleted.

escalatedAt.description: When it reached the platform's queue.

holdUntil.description: The retention purge skips the report until then.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; null on the last.

url.description: A short-lived GET URL for the reported object, or its evidence copy.

action.description: REMOVE_PHOTO: delete the reported photo. REMOVE_MEMBER: remove the reported member from the event and ban them from rejoining through the invitation link, deleting the reported photo too when the report is about one. DISMISS: nothing was wrong; hidden content returns. Every action closes all OPEN reports on the same target.

photos.description: REMOVE_MEMBER only (400 with any other action): what happens to the other photos the member uploaded to this event. KEEP (default): they stay. DELETE: they are all deleted, and their open reports are closed.

until.description: The retention purge keeps the report and its evidence until then.

reference.description: The CyberTipline report number, or the police file number.

submittedAt.description: When it was submitted. Defaults to now; the report is held for a year from then.

description.description: A new description, or null to remove it.

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limit exceeded; retry after the number of seconds in the Retry-After header
